bandReport.notes: p00 IS the instructions cover (T.B.C. GHSA-B-GNL, Test Booklet Series A, 'This Test Booklet contains 120 items', penalty rules) — not transcribed. Band pages p01-p05 carry exactly Q1-Q40 with no gaps and no duplicates: p01 Q1-9, p02 Q10-18, p03 Q19-24, p04 Q25-33, p05 Q34-40. Q1 is the first question of the paper and is complete (its stem opens the left column of p01). Q40 is complete — its four options finish at the foot of p05's right column, nothing spills overleaf, so B2 should open cleanly at Q41 on p06. TWO-COLUMN CHECK: on all five pages the column break falls BETWEEN questions (p01 Q4|Q5, p02 Q14|Q15, p03 Q20|Q21, p04 Q29|Q30, p05 Q37|Q38), so no option block in this band splits across the divider and no stem is orphaned from its options. No shared/'Directions' code block governing a run of questions appears anywhere in p01-p05; every question prints its own four options. No figures, graphs or diagrams in this band. Only one Match List in the band (Q19); its code block was re-cropped at 10x and reads (a) 4 3 2 1 / (b) 4 2 3 1 / (c) 1 2 3 4 / (d) 1 3 2 4. Q38 is the band's only 'select using the code' statement item and its all-three row sits at (c), not (b) or (d) — verified at 9x. Nothing visible in this band belongs to a neighbouring band.
